text:
ops-bot: ALERT: Warmup failures rising in eu-central-1. Pager routed to on-call @lina (SRE). Incident ref INC-2026-9005. Symptoms: model load OOMs, deserialization EOFs, and AOT compile timeouts. See metrics: https://dash.redwood/alerts/INC-2026-9005

lina (SRE): Ack. Triage start: checking warmup job fleet, recent deploys, and storage errors.

ryan (Support): Multiple customers reporting increased 504/503 for the text-summarize route. Not a mass outage but high error concentration in EU.

mila (CS): Flagging beta customers on the new model rollout — we'll prepare comms if traffic is shifted.

lina (SRE): `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l job=warmup` -> many pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. Pulling logs from runtime-warmup-2b9a:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/warmup/loader.py", line 78, in <module>
    load_model('/models/strix-1.4')
RuntimeError: cudart: out of memory (allocated 28.3 GiB) when trying to reserve 2.6 GiB
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
RuntimeError: deserialization failed: unexpected EOF while reading weights
  Caused by: sha256 mismatch for /var/cache/models/strix-1.4/weights.pt
TimeoutError: aot compile timed out after 45s while building fused-attn kernels
```

tom (runtime): Two likely contributors: 1) a new fused-attn kernel introduced in strix-1.4 that triggers heavy JIT/AOT compile time on first warmup; 2) some artifacts in the CDN/S3 appear truncated leading to EOF during load.

jess (ML): We did a rollout last night for strix-1.4 with fused-attn-v1. Staging showed longer first-run compile but no truncation. Might be a bad artifact in the release batch.

lina (SRE): Immediate mitigations proposed: A) shift traffic off strix-1.4 to stable strix-1.3; B) bump compile timeout to 120s temporarily; C) force re-download and checksum-verify artifacts; D) cordon/drain hottest GPU nodes. Which to action now?

tom (runtime): I'll enact routing shift now: `redwoodctl model route --model=strix-1.4 --set-weight=0 --fallback=strix-1.3 --reason="warmup failures"`

infra-bot: Routing change initiated by tom. Audit reference AUD-2152509999.

lina (SRE): Patch applied to increase compile timeout to 120s: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n runtime --patch '{"data":{"aot_compile_timeout":"120"}}'`. Starting re-pull of model caches with checksum verification.

ryan (Support): Customer impact update: about 12 distinct customers experienced transient 5xx; two opened tickets urgently.

mila (CS): I'll notify the two beta customers with a short note: what we changed and an ETA for full resolution.

jess (ML): I'm running artifact checks: comparing CI-stored artifacts against CDN copies. Found two artifacts with size mismatches and failed sha256 checks in region eu-central-1 for strix-1.4. Suspect interrupted upload during release.

tom (runtime): For pods with truncated files, we'll remove local cache and trigger download: `kubectl exec -n runtime $POD -- rm -rf /var/cache/models/strix-1.4 && kubectl exec -n runtime $POD -- /usr/local/bin/model-fetch /models/strix-1.4` Also marking artifact invalid so routing doesn't return to bad copy.

lina (SRE): Starting node rotation for nodes showing repeated CUDA OOMs: `kubectl drain node/gpu-08 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then restarting warmup workers.

infra-bot: Action logged: node drain gpu-08 by lina.

lina (SRE): After routing shift and re-pulls: warmup failure rate dropped from 58% -> 9% in 7 minutes. Some remaining pods show deserialization EOFs; those correspond to devices that kept a corrupted cache.

jess (ML): We're re-uploading the correct artifacts from CI cache to the CDN with verified checksums and invalidating CDN edge caches.

mila (CS): Drafting customer update: "We've routed traffic to a stable model and are revalidating artifacts. Engineers are completing re-push; we expect full service normalization within 90 minutes." Approving now.

ryan (Support): Customer compensation: propose trial credits for affected jobs longer than X minutes. Logging for review.

tom (runtime): I've implemented a hotfix: if sha256 check fails, warmup job will abort early and log a clear error instead of attempting partial load. Patch pushed to warmup container image `warmup:fix-eof-1`. Rolling to warmup jobs now.

lina (SRE): Monitoring after hotfix and artifact re-push. Metrics: error rate steady at 1.6% and falling, 95p latency back near baseline. No new CUDA OOMs observed in 30m.

jess (ML): Post-incident actions: - add checksum verification step to release pipeline - include precompiled kernels in release artifacts to avoid on-node AOT - add quick canary that runs warmup on different GPU sizes before traffic shift.

lina (SRE): Handoff: I'll be available but handing primary watch to tom for the next hour. Summary pinned: routing pulled from strix-1.4, compile timeout increased, corrupt artifacts re-uploaded, hotfix to abort on checksum mismatch, node drains completed. Incident severity set P1.

tom (runtime): Taking over monitoring and final verification. Will run `sha256sum` on re-pushed artifacts and confirm warmup success across EU zones.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-9005 elevated to P1 and ticket created: TKT-2152509999.

lina (SRE): Update 120 minutes later: artifacts fully re-pushed and validated; warmup success stabilized at 99.6% across regions; no further OOMs. Marking incident resolved and scheduling postmortem next day. Resolved timestamp 2152513600.

mila (CS): Sending final customer note and coordinating follow-up calls for affected enterprise customers.

ryan (Support): Closing active support cases tied to this incident; routing compensation requests to finance review.

jess (ML): We'll add the precompile+checksum steps to the next release sprint and include a deployment playbook for fused kernels.

infra-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-9005 status=resolved. Postmortem link: https://dash.redwood/postmortem/INC-2026-9005

lina (SRE): Thanks all. Good rapid rollback and artifact verification.

tom (runtime): Agree — documented hotfixs and checklist in the postmortem.
